summary: Sharing Economy International Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Non-Employee Director Agreement with Chairman/CEO Ximing Huang on August 11, 2026. The company issued one share of Series B Preferred Stock, carrying voting power equal to 51% of all outstanding common stock, in exchange for Huang's three-year board service. The preferred stock is convertible one-for-one into common stock and has no dividend rights. The transaction was a private placement under Section 4(a)(2), and it materially alters shareholder voting control. This is a capital-structure event, not a routine contract; watch for governance challenges or further dilutive actions.
